title: Ensure 'Audit client does not support encryption' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Server\Audit client does not support encryption to 'Enabled'
reason: Organizations should be aware of all unencrypted SMB traffic in their environment. Older SMB protocols that do not use encryption can make an environment susceptible to many types of attacks.

title: Ensure 'Audit client does not support signing' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Server\Audit client does not support signing to 'Enabled'
reason: Older SMB protocols that do not use signing can make an environment susceptible to many types of attacks, including SMB interception attacks.

title: Ensure 'Audit insecure guest logon' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Server\Audit insecure guest logon to 'Enabled'
reason: Insecure guest logons can be used by file servers to allow unauthenticated access to shared folders.

title: Ensure 'Enable authentication rate limiter' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Server\Enable authentication rate limiter to 'Enabled'
reason: Authentication rate limiter considerably reduces the risk of brute force attacks by implementing a 2-second delay between each failed NTLM or PKU2U-based authentication attempt.

title: Ensure 'Enable remote mailslots' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Server\Enable remote mailslots to 'Disabled'
reason: Remote mailslots is a legacy protocol that uses SMBv1 to function and is linked to known vulnerabilities.

title: Ensure 'Mandate the minimum version of SMB' is set to 'Enabled: 3.1.1'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Server\Mandate the minimum version of SMB to 'Enabled: 3.1.1'
reason: The newer, more modern version of SMB (v3) is supported and available. SMBv1 and SMBv2 carry security risks or lack encryption support.

title: Ensure 'Set authentication rate limiter delay (milliseconds)' is set to 'Enabled: 2000' or more
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Server\Set authentication rate limiter delay (milliseconds) to 'Enabled: 2000' or more
reason: Authentication rate limiter considerably reduces the risk of brute force attacks by implementing a delay.
